verdict.rationale: Kintsugi has a public API reference (e.g. Create Registration, Get Filings, Create Exemption pages) and ties code examples to it via SDKs and an MCP server that gives AI assistants 'accurate, up-to-date code examples,' but there is no evidence of an interactive 'try it' console or runnable examples in the docs, and the openapi.json probe returned 404s. missing for 10: explicit interactive/try-it execution UI, confirmation of a public OpenAPI spec, evidence of examples actually being runnable rather than just displayed code snippets.
